headline: Exxon, Chevron Warn Fuel Prices to Endure as War Knocks Refining
summary: (Bloomberg) -- High fuel prices are likely to stick around even if oil prices drop in the coming months as the wars in Russia and Middle East leave global refining capacity critically short, ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and Chevron Corp. warned.
